summary: Carlyle Credit Income Fund filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 Other Events solely to disclose management's unaudited NAV per common share of $3.32 as of June 30, 2026. No transaction, strategic initiative, or structural event is announced. The filing is a routine quarterly valuation update. As a non-US equivalent, this is akin to a monthly or quarterly NAV disclosure common for closed-end funds or BDCs. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors. The only item to watch is any subsequent NAV movement or discount trends; there is no risk-arb angle.
